//go:build e2e

package executor

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func pNum(sh string) int64 {
	out, _ := exec.Command("bash", "-c", ". "+os.Getenv("TRIAL_LIB")+"; "+sh).Output()
	var n int64
	_, _ = fmt.Sscan(string(out), &n)
	return n
}

func pStage(name string, fn func() error) error {
	rx, used, began := pNum("rx"), pNum("used"), time.Now()
	err := fn()
	row := fmt.Sprintf("%s\t%.1f\t%d\t%d\t%v\n", name, time.Since(began).Seconds(), pNum("rx")-rx, pNum("used")-used, err)
	f, _ := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("TRIAL_OUT"), "stages.tsv"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_APPEND|os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
	_, _ = f.WriteString(row)
	_ = f.Close()
	fmt.Print("STAGE ", row)
	df, _ := exec.Command("docker", "system", "df", "-v").CombinedOutput()
	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("TRIAL_OUT"), "df-"+strings.ReplaceAll(name, " ", "-")+".txt"), df, 0o600)
	return err
}

func pBuild(ctx context.Context, t *testing.T, e *Executor, name, app, dir, pkg string) error {
	var log bytes.Buffer
	tree := treeOf(t, dir)
	err := pStage(name, func() error { _, err := e.Build(ctx, BuildRequest{App: app, Package: pkg}, tree, &log); return err })
	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("TRIAL_OUT"), "log-"+strings.ReplaceAll(name, " ", "-")+".txt"), log.Bytes(), 0o600)
	return err
}

func TestProbe(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 75*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	node := &Executor{Join: []string{}, Builder: "canyon-builder-nodejs:trial"}
	today := &Executor{Join: []string{}}
	// The laptop demo with a Node builder alone: then a visitor's first Python app.
	_ = pStage("01 node builder made", func() error {
		if out, err := exec.Command("bash", "-c", "nodeonly").CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%v: %s", err, out)
		}
		return nil
	})
	_ = pStage("02 canyon-run", func() error { _, err := today.RunImageID(ctx); return err })
	_ = pBuild(ctx, t, node, "03 claims-portal on the node builder", "claims-portal", "../demo/apps/claims-portal", "pkg_prb1")
	_ = pStage("04 first python app: the full builder fetched and built", func() error { _, err := today.BuilderImage(ctx); return err })
	_ = pBuild(ctx, t, today, "05 first python app: its build", "django-sqlite", "testdata/apps/django-sqlite", "pkg_prb1")
	_ = pBuild(ctx, t, today, "06 the same python app again", "django-sqlite", "testdata/apps/django-sqlite", "pkg_prb2")
	// What the full builder sets for every build.
	builder, _ := today.BuilderImage(ctx)
	out, err := exec.Command("docker", "run", "--rm", "--network", "none", "--entrypoint", "sh", builder, "-c",
		`echo "image env:"; env | sort; echo; ls -laR /cnb/build-config 2>&1; for f in $(find /cnb/build-config -type f 2>/dev/null); do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done`).CombinedOutput()
	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("TRIAL_OUT"), "build-config.txt"), out, 0o600)
	fmt.Printf("CONFIG %v\n%s\n", err, out)
	paketo, _ := exec.Command("docker", "image", "inspect", "--format", "{{json .Config.Env}} {{json .Config.Labels}}", builder).Output()
	_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("TRIAL_OUT"), "builder-inspect.json"), paketo, 0o600)
	// claims-portal on today's builder: fresh, again with its caches, then again with them removed.
	_ = pBuild(ctx, t, today, "07 claims-portal fresh", "cp-cache", "../demo/apps/claims-portal", "pkg_prb1")
	_ = pBuild(ctx, t, today, "08 claims-portal again, caches kept", "cp-cache", "../demo/apps/claims-portal", "pkg_prb2")
	_ = exec.Command("docker", "volume", "rm", "canyon-cache-cp-cache-build", "canyon-cache-cp-cache-launch").Run()
	_ = pBuild(ctx, t, today, "09 claims-portal again, caches removed", "cp-cache", "../demo/apps/claims-portal", "pkg_prb3")
	_ = pBuild(ctx, t, today, "10 claims-portal again, caches kept", "cp-cache", "../demo/apps/claims-portal", "pkg_prb4")
	_ = exec.Command("docker", "volume", "rm", "canyon-cache-cp-cache-build", "canyon-cache-cp-cache-launch").Run()
	_ = pBuild(ctx, t, today, "11 claims-portal again, caches removed", "cp-cache", "../demo/apps/claims-portal", "pkg_prb5")
	// One build's phases timed, today's builder and the node builder, caches kept.
	must(t, os.WriteFile("/tmp/probe-verbose", nil, 0o600))
	_ = pBuild(ctx, t, today, "12 timed phases, today's builder", "cp-cache", "../demo/apps/claims-portal", "pkg_prb6")
	_ = pBuild(ctx, t, node, "13 timed phases, node builder", "claims-portal", "../demo/apps/claims-portal", "pkg_prb7")
	must(t, os.Remove("/tmp/probe-verbose"))
}
